body: 2026-10-03, 02:57 to 03:25: the owner asked to "Fix both in one PR and clear the old containers... There is no requirement to preserve any testing data. Clear it fully." #256 merged at 08:56Z.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Containers.**U+000AU+002D The eight old test containers (axprobe, dmgs, gbench, manual, mbench, nprobe, probe and v7) were emptied with rm. macOS keeps each folder plus its protected .com.apple.containermanagerd.metadata.plist (about 32 KB) and refuses to move or delete the folder itself.U+000AU+002D The plain container's .bak journals were deleted, and so was ~/.Trash/field-notes-old-builds-2026-10-03 (5.3 GB).U+000AU+002D The real-ID container dev.satanshumishra.fieldNotes was NOT touched. It holds 3 days (2026-09-21 to 2026-09-23) and 4 notes, and is pending the owner's answer.U+000AU+002D Memory test-data-is-disposable records the owner's preference.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Toast finding corrected.**U+000AU+002D A 10 fps screenrecord on the emulator showed the steady-state toast is opaque enough that the hint is hidden; only 'write a' peeks out at its left.U+000AU+002D The defect is the roughly 0.3 s fade-in. The toast faded through an Opacity or FadeTransition layer around a BackdropFilter, so the blur has nothing behind it to blur and the hint shows sharply through.U+000AU+002D The app's shared transient toast (FadeTransition) had the same flaw.U+000AU+000AU+002A*PR https://github.com/SatanshuMishra/field-notes/pull/257** (branch fix/meadow-status-bar-and-note-toast, bound to this session):U+000AU+002D bc5815a3 fix(shell):U+000A  U+002D New lib/app/shell/system_bars.dart: lightBackdropSystemBars, darkBackdropSystemBars, systemBarsOver(Brightness) and systemBarsOverColor(Color), the last via ThemeData.estimateBrightnessForColor.U+000A  U+002D app.dart uses systemBarsOver.U+000A  U+002D The BottomBarShell header wraps an AnnotatedRegion: dark backdrop when overScene, otherwise the theme. The innermost region wins at the status bar.U+000A  U+002D MeadowFullScreen wraps systemBarsOverColor(sky.skyTop).U+000A  U+002D Tests: test/app/shell/phone_status_bar_test.dart, plus full-screen night and afternoon cases in meadow_full_screen_test. A baseline style is set first so a stale SystemChrome.latestStyle cannot pass.U+000AU+002D cc8467c0 fix(glass):U+000A  U+002D GlassSurface gains an `opacity`. It scales the blur sigma and saturation through glassBackdropFilterAt, fades the tint, edge, highlight and child with an Opacity inside the BackdropFilter, scales the shadow alpha, and turns the backdrop off at 0.U+000A  U+002D Toast gains `opacity`. _TransientToastLayer drops its FadeTransition for an AnimatedBuilder with ExcludeSemantics at 0.U+000A  U+002D The onboarding _ToastSlot drops its Opacity.U+000A  U+002D Tests: glass_toast_test and onboarding_swipe_test assert that no fading opacity layer sits above the toast's BackdropFilter mid-rise.U+000AU+002D All new tests were red first.U+000AU+002D Full suite: analyze clean, 29 folders pass, and the design and Meadow goldens are unchanged.U+000AU+002D Emulator: white status icons over the Meadow header and full-screen night in the light theme, and dark icons on Today. A recording shows the hint blurred during the fade-in.U+000AU+002D Screens in docs/specs/screens: statusbar-light-theme-fixed.png, statusbar-fullscreen-night-fixed.png, statusbar-today-light-fixed.png, toast-fade-before.png and toast-fade-after.png.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Installs.**U+000AU+002D Mac ~/Applications plain and fresh rebuilt from cc8467c0. The fresh Documents were cleared so onboarding reruns.U+000AU+002D The Note 10+ disconnected before its update. device-pass/update_phone.zsh installs apps-fix2 plain and fresh with -r and pm-clears fresh.U+000AU+002D Superseded APKs and duplicate .app copies were removed. device-pass keeps apps/mbench.apk and sbench.apk (9e41b3ba) for the S24 Ultra, and apps-fix2 plain.apk and fresh.apk.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Worktrees.** fix-followups and its merged branch fix/device-pass-followups were removed, and so was fix2-build. fix-statusbar-toast is kept until #257 merges. The lab was released with nothing left behind.
